# Turnover Margin

> **Two source classes on this page, never mixed in one claim.** *How the guide defines it*, *how the guide uses it* and every page reference are **GUIDE CONTENT**. *Working definition*, *why it matters* and any arithmetic over printed figures are **TTW DERIVED** — this library's words, supplied because the guide supplies none. ## How the guide defines it

p. 2 glosses `TO – Turnovers`. Margin itself is not defined.

## How the guide uses it

Turnovers are a printed statistical category on both the offensive and defensive tables for all 138 teams. In prose the guide reaches for turnover margin when explaining a collapse — Florida State's -25 margin since the 2023 playoff field was announced is offered on p. 13 as the summary figure for the programme's decline.

## Working definition — TTW DERIVED

Takeaways minus giveaways, over a stated span.

## Why it matters — TTW DERIVED

The guide uses it as evidence that a record was not earned, in either direction. A heavy negative margin attached to a poor record suggests the record may be worse than the team; the guide's contributors invoke it when arguing a team is due to move.

## How bettors use it in this guide

Retrospectively and rhetorically rather than as a projection input. No contributor prints an expected turnover margin for 2026.

p. 2 for the abbreviation; every team's right-hand page for the printed counts; p. 13 for the clearest worked use.
